summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py following docs/CONVENTIONS.md (integer cents, conservation, leftover cents to earliest entries, refunds split on absolute value and negated, ValueError for parties <= 0) and added tests; all 57 tests pass.
assumptions: total is in integer cents (per ledger/money.py and CONVENTIONS rule 1), so split_amount(1000, 3) returns [334, 333, 333] rather than float shares.
docs/CONVENTIONS.md is the authoritative specification for remainder, refund and invalid-count handling, since the task text does not cover them and split.py references it.
Non-integer inputs (floats, bools) are rejected with TypeError; the conventions do not specify this, but rule 1 forbids floats for money.
